# emby_libraries (Data Source)

Lists all libraries (virtual folders) on the Emby server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List all libraries on the Emby server.
data "emby_libraries" "all" {}

output "library_names" {
  value = keys(data.emby_libraries.all.libraries)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `libraries` (Attributes Map) The libraries keyed by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--libraries))

<a id="nestedatt--libraries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `libraries`

Read-Only:

- `collection_type` (String) The collection type (e.g. movies, tvshows, music).
- `id` (String) The library ID.
- `item_id` (String) The internal item ID used for policy bindings (e.g. EnabledFolders).
- `locations` (List of String) The file system paths for the library.
- `name` (String) The library name.
